meta.plaintext_alphabet: string.ascii_letters + string.digits; one fixed plaintext via random.Random(20260909)
meta.checksum_definition: SHA-256(nonce || ciphertext), unkeyed, verified by verify_and_remove_checksum before any key use
meta.acceptance_predicate: nucleotide-alphabet validity of the decrypted material (cha_decrypt ACGU branch), then inverse substitution
meta.note_c: scenario (c) is cited from ablation_measure B5 and intentionally not re-run

a_checksum_bypass.description: flip 1 random bit in the ciphertext body, recompute SHA-256(nonce||ciphertext) and replace the checksum, submit to the full frozen decryption pipeline

control_no_recompute.description: same single-bit flips, checksum left untouched

b_known_plaintext_selected_change.description: known-plaintext selected change: material symbol 'A'(0x41) -> 'G'(0x47) (XOR delta 0x0006, 2 bits) applied to the corresponding ciphertext byte, checksum recomputed and replaced, full decryption run

c_random_bitflip_reference.description: random single-bit ciphertext corruption (no checksum recomputation by definition of the corruption model), reference only - measured in ablation_measure/results.json exp2 B5, not re-run here
